name: picks-league
description: A serverless Discord picks league: Cloudflare Workers + D1, no bot process

DISCORD_TOKEN.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot tab, Reset Token).

DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID.description: Application ID from the Developer Portal's General Information page.

DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Public Key from the same page; used to verify every request from Discord.

GUILD_ID.description: The id of the one Discord server this bot serves.
